events.verdict: Okongwu (ATL) establishes himself in Wagner's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Wagner (ORL) and Johnson (ATL) come together at the same spot at the start of the drive.
Carter Jr. (ORL) legally contests Johnson's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) and Wagner (ORL) engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Okongwu (ATL) dislodges the ball from Suggs (ORL).  The ensuing contact that occurs as they attempt to secure possession, which causes them to go to the floor, is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Banchero's (ORL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) establishes himself in Suggs' (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Suggs (ORL) directly contests Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Alexander-Walker's hand after the release.

Wiggins (ATL) pulls Banchero's (ORL) hand off the ball.  The contact occurs after Banchero's gather on a drive that originates outside of, and could end inside, the lower defensive box.  A shooting foul should have been assessed.
Banchero (ORL) brings his hand towards Wiggins (ATL) and he releases away from the contact.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Wagner (ORL) and Alexander-Walker (ATL) engage and disengage off-ball.
Bane (ORL) straddles the lane line and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Wagner (ORL) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Johnson (ATL) engage and disengage during the pick.
Okongwu (ATL) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Daniels (ATL) come together at the same spot as they pursue the rebound.
Carter Jr. (ORL) grazes Johnson's (ATL) arm as he secures the rebound.
Suggs (ORL) commits a take foul on Johnson (ATL).

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Carter Jr. (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. There is no clear and conclusive camera angle to determine which player touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.  Therefore, the ruling on the court (Hawks ball) stood as called.
Suggs (ORL) commits a take foul on Okongwu (ATL).  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined no additional penalties would be assessed.
